note: Rusk County Parks campground about 3 mi NE of Tony where Josie Creek meets the Dairyland Flowage (South Fork Flambeau River impoundment), with a boat launch on the flowage and a county shooting range (50, 100 and 600 yd) beside the campground. ATVs and UTVs are not allowed in the campground. --Claude
summary: Rusk County reservation pages (campground, 22 per-site pages, alerts, rules, map), county forestry page and imagery read. flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The county map draws Josie Creek along the south side of sites J10-J12 and J14-J23, but the creek is a small stream (well under 30 m; creekside at most) and Esri shows the whole camping area under continuous canopy with the creek invisible, so no site can be placed on open ground by it. The Dairyland Flowage is ~250 m NW of the sites at the boat landing.
PIN 45.5197,-90.9658 sits on Josie Creek Road ~50 m S of the pay-station junction (about 45.5201,-90.9661): fine.
